problems.title: Missing outcome predictions are omitted from balanced-accuracy denominators
problems.claim_location: Paper§5.1 p7, Table2 p8; baorina/CGOT_release e8950cf327b0 src/eval/task4_report_outcome.py lines47-83; same loop in original repository d9238f5742d9
problems.claim: Outcome metric is average per-class accuracy, but current evaluator increments denominators only after successful answer lookup.
assumptions: Missing answer keys activate existing KeyError branch
Both classes retain one answer, so no zero-division needed
problems.check: Independent count arithmetic: correct=(1,1), full denominator=(2,2), available denominator=(1,1). Static loop comparison verifies both saved releases retain same logic.
problems.result: Printed balanced accuracy1.0 versus full cohort0.5; ordinary accuracy0.5. Entire missing class can cause division by zero.
problems.counterevidence: No effect if no answers missing. Conditional selective accuracy could be intentional if labeled with class coverage; paper provides no such qualifier. No historical responses were loaded.
problems.impact: Supported local release defect; numerical effect on paper score and core contribution unestablished, so Minor.
problems.correction: Count class denominators from all eligible labeled cases before lookup; missing/invalid answers receive no correct credit, and report coverage separately.

independent_verification.source_claim: Read original p7 definition of mean accuracy across output categories and the source loop lines47-83 in both saved releases. The KeyError/continue precedes class denominator increments.
independent_verification.assumptions_verified: Four nonempty eligible label records 0,0,1,1; answer dictionary contains two correctly formatted answers and omits one key per class. Thus list(cur_ans.keys())[0] exists, .split handling is well-defined for supplied answers, both class denominators remain positive, and missing keys take the actual KeyError branch.

decisive_check.method: Independent exact Fraction arithmetic plus static control-flow reading, without running/importing author code

independent_verification.counterevidence: With no missing answers the two metrics agree; selective accuracy is legitimate if explicitly declared with class coverage. The paper notes some refusals, but does not supply outcome response arrays, so this observation cannot quantify historical score impact.
independent_verification.core_dependency: The released outcome evaluator computes a core task metric, but May2026 source is not established as the historical2025 code and missingness of that run is unknown.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Retain Minor for the demonstrated release defect. Do not promote unknown historical impact to Major. Fixed true-label denominators plus explicit missing/invalid policy restore the specified full-cohort arithmetic only, not clinical validity or historical score reconstruction.
